announcements.title: Overhead Water Tank Cleaning & Brief Supply Pause
announcements.summary: Routine quarterly sanitization of Block B overhead tanks scheduled for Sunday, 29 Nov (10:00 AM – 1:00 PM).
announcements.body: Dear Residents, quarterly chlorination and cleaning of the Block B overhead and sump tanks will take place on Sunday, 29 November 2026 between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM. Please store sufficient water in advance. Normal supply will resume promptly by 1:15 PM.

announcements.title: Monthly General Committee Meeting — December Agenda
announcements.summary: Association members will meet on Saturday, 5 Dec at 5:30 PM in the Clubhouse Lounge.
announcements.body: Agenda items include review of solar pathway lighting quotes, rainwater pit desilting before summer, and Q4 security roster updates. Residents are welcome to submit agenda suggestions to the Secretary by Wednesday.

announcements.title: Passenger Lift Annual Preventive Servicing
announcements.summary: Scheduled technician inspection on Tuesday, 2 Dec between 11:00 AM and 12:30 PM.
announcements.body: Our AMC engineering team will inspect safety interlocks, cabin alignment, and emergency alarm battery backup on Tuesday morning. Kindly use the staircase during the 90-minute servicing window.

announcements.title: Segregated Wet & Dry Waste Pickup Timings
announcements.summary: Morning collection begins at 8:15 AM daily; please keep green and blue bins ready.
announcements.body: To maintain hygiene in corridors and assist our housekeeping staff, kindly place separated wet waste (green bin) and dry recyclables (blue bin) outside before 8:15 AM.

announcements.title: November Maintenance Dues & Door-Lock Declaration Reminder
announcements.summary: Residents may view dues and download official numbered PDF receipts inside the Resident Corner.
announcements.body: Please verify your November maintenance statement in the Resident Corner. Owners opting for vacant door-lock concession must inform the Secretary in advance before the monthly bill cycle.

complaints.subject: 1st Floor staircase landing sensor light flickering
complaints.description: The motion-sensor LED tube near the 1st floor east landing flickers intermittently after 7 PM.
complaints.resolutionNotes: Replacement ballast driver ordered; scheduled for evening check.

complaints.subject: Low water pressure in kitchen utility line
complaints.description: Water flow drops between 7:30 AM and 8:30 AM on the 2nd floor west wing.

documents.title: Happy Homes Palace-B OWA Bye-Laws & House Rules
documents.summary: Approved association governance bye-laws, parking etiquette, renovation timings, and pet guidelines.
documents.content: 1. Quiet hours: 10:30 PM to 6:30 AM. 2. Interior renovation work permitted Mon–Sat 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM only. 3. Door-lock maintenance concession requires prior written intimation to the Secretary.

documents.title: FY 2026 Maintenance Tariff & Concession Policy
documents.summary: AGM-approved standard monthly maintenance of ₹1,200 per flat and 50% door-lock concession rules.
documents.content: Standard Monthly Maintenance: ₹1,200/month effective Jan 2026. Vacant / Door-Lock flats certified by the committee receive a 50% concession (₹600/month). Official numbered PDF receipts are issued upon bank reference verification.
